text.card: A red giant 3,500 parsecs away, 13 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 12, give 1.34 solar masses and 12.9 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 5,061 K at its surface.
